notes.title: New Update for Cell DefenderV1.2
notes.content:
1. Increase Russian, Thai, Korean versions.
2. Character selection scene adds instructions.
3. Fix the error that can't attack when character 2 and 3 are still.
4. Fix the character 1's back gun error.

[b]Notice:[/b]
Please insert all the controllers after entering the game. 
If there are still problems, just dial down all the controllers and restart the game.
